settings.heading: Compression socks, designed by an Orthotist

settings.text: Sized by your ankle, not your shoe

settings.heading: Designed with purpose
settings.text: [compression] compression, graduating from firmest at the ankle to lighter pressure up the leg.
settings.closing: Firm where it starts. Lighter as it rises.
settings.figure_label: A leg wrapped in three bands: firmest at the ankle, easing at the calf, lightest below the knee.

settings.text:
Made with a carefully selected blend of combed cotton, polyamide and elastane for a soft feel, comfortable stretch and lasting wear.

It's a blend chosen to stay comfortable all year round, whether it's winter or summer.

settings.image_alt: Close-up of the knitted fabric of a Daisy knee-high compression sock with the Vital Socks logo on its purple cuff

settings.heading: Twelve hours on your feet
settings.text: Nurses, chefs, cabin crew, retail. If the shift is long, the socks should be doing some of the work. Espresso was drawn for the double-shift crowd.

settings.heading: Long-haul legs
settings.text: Long flights and long drives mean hours in one seat. Pull on Checker before you board.

settings.alt: Legs in Cherry Pop compression socks and white sneakers on a step against a sky-blue wall
settings.heading: Loud on purpose
settings.text: Colourful and expressive, on purpose. Cherry Pop is the proof.

settings.heading: Everyday compression for everyday legs.
settings.text: Designed for tired, heavy or fatigued legs, including during long days standing, sitting or travelling.
settings.head_alt: A nurse in Espresso and a runner in Black knee-high compression socks, standing back to back and smiling with arms folded

settings.heading: Your legs. Your style. Your compression.
settings.text:
Compression doesn't have to look clinical.

Whether you prefer something classic, subtle, colourful or expressive, our collection brings [compression] graduated compression into styles you'll actually want to wear.

Because supportive socks should fit into your life—not stand out from it.

settings.portrait_alt: Farida Cajee-Botes, Orthotist & Prosthetist and designer of Vital Socks
settings.heading: Professional knowledge behind every pair.
settings.quote: Compression is more than making a sock tight. As an Orthotist & Prosthetist, I wanted to create an everyday compression sock with thoughtful fit, function and comfort.
settings.text: Our socks are intended for everyday compression. If you have a medical condition, persistent swelling, or think you may need therapeutic compression, speak to our Orthotist before purchasing.
